title: Shotgun Vendetta
summary: Shotgun Vendetta is a Primary Arcane that, when killing an enemy within 5 meters with a shotgun, increases Multishot and Reload Speed for 15 seconds.
extract:
Shotgun Vendetta is a Primary Arcane that, when killing an enemy within 5 meters with a shotgun, increases Multishot and Reload Speed for 15 seconds.

Effect

Acquisition
May appear in The Circuit's progress tree on The Steel Path as Tier 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, or +11 reward on a weekly rotational basis.
May be sold by Acrithis for 10  Pathos Clamp on a daily rotational basis, requiring Drifter Intrinsics Opportunity Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
May drop from Undercroft portals in the Duviri Experience while on Steel Path.
